يكتسحوا (form VIII)
# يَكْتَسِحُوا (yaktasiḥū) /jak.ta.si.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# يُكْتَسَحُوا (yuktasaḥū) /juk.ta.sa.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
